newsitem.title: USA: Ansan to merge with Discovery Labs.
newsitem.headline: Ansan to merge with Discovery Labs.

text.p: Ansan Pharmaceuticals Inc said Friday that it entered into an agreement and plan of reorganization and merger with Discovery Laboratories Inc., a privately held development stage biotechnology company.
Discovery will be merged with and into Ansan, a news release issued by Ansan said.

The parties also entered into a stock purchase agreement in which Discovery purchased shares of a new class of convertible preferred stock of Ansan for $1.3 million, representing a common stock equivalent price of $1.40 per share, the news release said.
